correctness.rationale: Reconstructed theorem for all 0<a<1, h>0 and integer k>=1: direct Exp(1) truncation moments U,V,W, stationary recursion variance, exact runoff covariance N, positive D, exact difference rho-a=zG/D and exact derivative positive factor times H=2(1-z)-(1-a)h. Strict convexity of G, strict concavity of H, sign at crossing and L2 endpoints prove each quantifier and uniqueness. The exact-rational checker tested the polynomial derivative identity on 1500 triples, with further independent scalar, finite-difference and limit tests (1724 total assertions). Finite tests are supplementary.

originality.rationale: Within the full scientific statements inspected, no stronger or equivalent result gives the exact threshold-classified runoff-greater-than-store memory, unique global optimization, and all-positive-lag common maximizer for iid exponential precipitation with threshold-overflow routing. Generic stationary AR(1) algebra and fast/slow routing are acknowledged prior ingredients, not claimed as original. Closest evidence consists of Berghuijs et al. 2024/2025 nonlinear/hysteretic simulations, Schuite et al. 2019 analytic transfer functions and Weiler et al. 2003 tracer-based partition. Historical priority is provisional; inaccessible 1995 and broader nonlinear routing literature are disclosed risks.
residual_risks: No systematic exhaustive historical search can establish mathematical novelty; especially early single-reservoir quickflow/baseflow stochastic models may contain a stronger derived result.
Ramos et al. 1995, DOI 10.1029/95WR00234, full text was inaccessible; its title suggests state-space methods, not a decisive direct coverage implication.
Classical ARMA(1,1) formulae plus exponential truncation supply some ingredients; the explicit sharp threshold and maximizer nevertheless require additional derivation.
The theorem is a simple idealized mathematical model, not a direct ecological generalization to arbitrary rainfall distributions.

value.rationale: The motivating empirical annual-memory literature documents near-white annual rainfall with persistent storage and outflow. This exact mass-conserving one-store nonlinear partition shows a surprising inversion: runoff can have greater lag autocorrelation than its sole memory-bearing storage, and uniquely identifies the infiltration cap that maximizes this effect and the onset threshold. The complete sharp result serves as a mechanistic benchmark, rather than an arbitrary numerical parameter example. Narrow physical scope and historical residual risks are disclosed.
